info.title: Sure Personal Finance & Wealth API
info.description: Multi-tenant personal finance and wealth management REST API v1 and MCP JSON-RPC endpoint. All monetary amounts are serialized strictly as decimal strings (`DecimalString`), and every financial resource is scoped to the authenticated family (`req.auth.familyId`).

tags.name: System
tags.description: Health, version metadata, and self-hosted OpenAPI documentation

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication, MFA (TOTP), password management, and scoped API keys

tags.name: Family
tags.description: Family multi-tenant settings, member invitations, and full JSON backup export

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Polymorphic accounts (Asset & Liability), loan amortization, and investment holdings

tags.name: Entries
tags.description: Transactions, valuations, trades, transfers, split transactions, and bulk updates

tags.name: Imports
tags.description: CSV/file import preview, rule evaluation on commit, and rollback revert

tags.name: Rules
tags.description: Deterministic automation rules (dry-run preview and execution)

tags.name: Budgets & Goals
tags.description: Monthly category budgets, savings/debt goals, and recurring bill series

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Net worth, income statement, category rollup, and normal spending trend breakdowns

tags.name: Sync
tags.description: Provider connections (SimpleFIN/Plaid/Manual), sync runs, and conflict resolution

tags.name: AI
tags.description: Consent-gated AI insights, auto-categorization, and financial chat

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint for read/write financial tools
